meta.title: Day 1 of 5: The Break Room, the Locker Room, and the Green Room
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 1 of 5: the party starts in the Z6 Break Room, nothing collapses (tutorial pace), and three routes to the stairwell (dash, loot, clever) are laid out with five encounters, a Stairwell key findable three ways, loot and achievement hooks from existing decks and tables, and a stall fallback. clock.zone_groups: Confirmed (decision 026, tagged inspired): outer zones (Z0 to Z4 plus 3b) close Day 2; mid zones (Z5, Z7 and Z8) close Day 3; on Day 4 the Break Room (Z6) and vendors lose service; on Day 5 only the corridor (Z10, Z11 and Z S) remains. The Z9 Green Room saferoom stays open to the end (inspired). Closed means hooks and services vanish; the route (Z6, Z8, Z9, Z10, Z11) is never cut.
clock.stairwell_opens: About 32 hours after the floor opens, early Day 2 (canon M-276, VERIFIED). The Z10 boss arena also holds a stairwell (canon M-275). The Stairwell key and the Zone S door are house ideas, tagged inspired.
clock.early_descent: A Crawler who descends with more than 6 hours left on the floor is held in stasis until the floor collapses (canon M-277, VERIFIED): this banks the achievement and ends that Crawler's floor. In the last 6 hours, descent is free. Each Crawler chooses for themselves; the GM may override with a logged reason.
clock.collapse_order_status: confirmed per decision 026; the steps only remove hooks and services, and the Detour Tax is the only toll on the clock (a missed Stairwell key only)

final_collapse.status: Syndicate default, decision 026; Caleb may veto
final_collapse.text: The final collapse comes at a FIXED moment: 24 in-game hours into Day 5 (hour 120 of the floor). A Long Rest never ends the floor and never skips it; the System cuts short any rest that would run past the collapse.

collapse_miss.tag: canon-aligned (canon: a missed collapse ends the run)
collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death rules follow Core section 6 (death is pretty much game over). Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.
collapse_miss.stasis_counts: Early-descent stasis (canon M-277) counts as reaching a stairwell.
collapse_miss.detour_tax_scope: The Detour Tax now covers only a missed Stairwell key, never a missed collapse.

saferoom_rule.text: The Break Room (Z6) is a saferoom through Day 3 and stops being one when it loses service on Day 4 (Syndicate ruling, decision 026). From then on the Z9 Green Room is the only saferoom, open to the end of the floor (tagged inspired).

clock.achievement_caps: Floor caps still apply: the soft cap is 2 to 3 achievement boxes per Crawler per floor (Caleb's ruling); on Floors 1 and 2 the Silver ceiling and one Story Box per floor hold. Rewards are tailored by the GM and snark-only is allowed; the proposed achievements are a seed list at GM discretion.

rest_fee_note.text: GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

day.stall_fallback: Day 1 has no collapse, so stalling only costs clock. If the party loiters in the Break Room, the System posts short-rest and Long Rest reminders, the corkboard rumors repeat, and the Lights-Out hour arrives on schedule (enc-d01-04). If they refuse to pick a route, the vending terminal offers the bribe in enc-d01-01 and the speaker announces what the clock will do tomorrow. If the day rolls over at the 24-hour mark without a Long Rest, the System still posts the Day 2 notice; the party simply rests later at an honest saferoom. The Floor 1 Reprieve does not cover a missed collapse: that is death on every floor (decision 026), so say so at the start.
day.start_note: Default start is the Break Room (Z6), where session one ended after the Floor 1 Reprieve ejected both Crawlers there. Later days start in the Green Room if the party rested there, otherwise wherever the day rolled over.

rest_options.note: Honest saferoom through Day 3; it stops being a saferoom when it loses service on Day 4 (decision 026).
Honest saferoom; open to the end of the floor (inspired). The default Long Rest that closes Day 1 and brings level 2.

A field rest can only be a Short Rest (Core section 5.6: Long Rests only in saferooms). The rest-without-a-saferoom price (rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom) buys a quiet Short Rest and grants no Long Rest; unpaid or noisy, Ceiling Ticks interrupt it (00-overview.md section 2 rule 7). A saferoom is where the day's Long Rest happens (the Break Room through Day 3, the Green Room always). GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

system_intro.text: Oh, we're speed-running. Cute. The stairwell is behind the stage, and the stage comes with a Dean. Every room between here and there wants to meet you, and none of them are polite about it.

midpoint_twist.text: Halfway there and nobody has read a single sign. The audience is already betting on who trips first. Keep moving, or don't. The odds board loves variety.

win.text: You beat the clock to the stage door, and the door isn't open yet. Impressive and useless. Sit tight. Stairs unlock early tomorrow, and the audience is betting on how bored you get.

routes.path: Z6, then last-chance backtrack hooks (the unplayed Z4 and Z5 and the rest of Z3), then Z7 (bait stairs and the Back Office), Z8, Z9 (rest, level 2), then the Z S service corridor and the service stairwell (skips the boss).
routes.summary: Spend the day collecting: outer-zone hooks (Z4 and the rest of Z3 were never cleared) before they close, the Greeters' Back Office, the Locker Room, the Green Room boxes. Ends at the service door in Zone S rather than the boss. Slow means the clock bites: each day the floor closes more of what you came to collect.

system_intro.text: A thorough Crawler. How rare. Every closet has a secret and every secret has a price tag. Take your time, but not too much of it.

midpoint_twist.text: You're carrying more stuff than a flea market and the floor is a day closer to coming down. Fascinating priorities. Keep going; the shiny things get thinner by the hour.

win.text: You found the back stairs with full pockets and a long achievement list. Management calls that 'engaged'. Everyone else calls it 'a lot of backpack'.

routes.name: Clever route: Talk, Trade, Sneak (Break Room, vendors, bribe)
routes.path: Z6 (corkboard, terminal, Complaint Card) to Z8 (use the room, not the weapons) to Z9 to the Z S service door with a bought or found key.
routes.summary: Use the Break Room: read the corkboard, ask the terminal about the unlisted spare key, spend the single-use oracle on the right yes or no question. Get through the Locker Room by wits where possible, rest in the Green Room, and slip through Zone S. Vendors lose service on Day 4 (confirmed order, decision 026), so the bribe is a deadline, not a permanent option.
routes.stairwell_access: Zone S service door with the bought key, the Mystery Key, or Bruiser's key; keyless forcing is the costly fallback.

system_intro.text: Ooh, a negotiator. The vending terminal has opinions, the corkboard has gossip, and everything in this building has a price. Some of it is even legal.

midpoint_twist.text: Look at you, avoiding the part where you get hit. The audience can't decide if that's smart or cowardly. Ratings say 'confused'. That's a compliment.

win.text: You reached the exit without a scratch and, in one case, without a sign. Is it cheating? The System checked twice and the paperwork says no. Infuriating.

system_intro.text: EXIT! A big, friendly sign with a countdown now, in case you weren't tempted enough. Listen: birds, and there have never been birds down here.

midpoint_twist.text: The floor drops out, the clipboards come out, and a very polite goblin in a green vest asks if you have an appointment. You do not.

win.text: The greeters are down and the back office is open: a workshop full of unapproved inventory. Management is furious and also taking notes. The sign still says EXIT. It's still lying.

win_alt.text: You smelled freedom, said no, and kept your feet. The sign goes dim. That's the System's way of nodding. It does not nod often.
